analysis_constants.name: MW equality and forcing classification tolerance
analysis_constants.source: DR IMPL-ISL-20 D2; inherited analysis convention tools/dr_isl/ISL19_REPORT.md:72

analysis_constants.name: Counterfactual R
analysis_constants.source: NERC Reliability Guideline: Primary Frequency Control, September 2023, Chapter 4/Table 4.2; recommends governor settings not exceeding 3–5% depending on unit type

classification: Invalid ticks: curtailment > epsilon first; else forcing < -epsilon; else |forcing| <= epsilon carried; else positive forcing without curtailment. Four disjoint classes; validity is engine frequency_valid, not an analysis filter.
episodes: Maximal consecutive carried-invalid tick intervals. Duration=count*5s; predecessor and successor include forcing and class. New forcing uses public forcing or nonzero integrated raw forcing. Observation is right-censored at run end.
damping: tau=2H/D_eff; D_eff=0 means infinite tau; homogeneous discrete prediction f0+(f_start-f0)*(1-D_eff*dt_sub/(2H))**n_sub compared against actual end frequency on zero-forcing ticks.
counterfactual: Process-only AST adds the limited droop term to _last_integrated_frequency_forcing_mw before _p_net_pu. No writes to dispatched MW, SoC, ledger or guard thresholds. Native frequency/protection feedback remains enabled; any resulting output/ledger changes are reported, not suppressed.
headroom: Instantaneous on-bus synchronous rated-output raising, output-minimum lowering; diesel existing dispatch_floor_mw; nontripped grid-forming BESS anchor-adjusted power and AC stored-energy ceiling for dt_sub, charge space and efficiency for lowering. These are physical headroom bounds, not funded dispatch/reserve permissions. No additional SoC debit is made by this hypothetical forcing term, so integral response energy is not real delivered energy and must be funded in any implementation.
percentiles: Linear interpolation of sorted empirical observations; no cutoffs or smoothing.
evidence_boundary: Only aggregate summaries, episode records, ten representative carried ticks per case, verbatim source and JSON metadata. No full per-tick export; no CSV. Scratch scripts outside tracked tree.
measurement_completion: Eight baseline/droop pairs complete; all baseline non-frequency hashes match D11t. An additional short fc100-zero full-field pair isolates nine status-only differences and confirms identical ledger.
balance_serialization_note: BalanceResult.passed is a property, not a serialized field. No pass/fail count is inferred from an absent passed field; identity comparisons include the actual full ledger.
counterfactual_physical_effects: Real unit MW, SoC, served/unserved and curtailment unchanged in all eight; fuel unchanged, proven by full non-frequency equality except fc100-zero where only ride-through-status differs. No direct unit/ledger write; native frequency feedback remains enabled.
representative_count_note: fc100-zero has only seven distinct carried ticks: all seven, not duplicated to ten.
